summary: Comprehensive button-sweep across every screen for Contractor OS. Backend: 19/20 pytest pass (1 pre-existing unrelated test_auth_me case-sensitivity failure). Frontend UI sweep with jane@acme.com.au covered AUTH, DASHBOARD, QUOTES (list + builder + detail), ESTIMATOR, CRM, JOBS. CRITICAL REGRESSION on restructured Quote card VERIFIED FIXED: tapping quote-advance-<id> and quote-tojob-<id> perform ONLY their action and do NOT open the quote-detail modal (nested-Pressable bubbling issue resolved). All primary onPress handlers wired and firing: toggle-mode-button (login<->register), auth-submit-button (bad creds shows auth-error, good creds logs in), logout-button (clears session but see BUG below), Quotes FAB (quote-add-button) opens Quote Builder, add-line-button opens rate picker, rate-<id> adds line + qty-input-0 editable, recommend-margins-button fills contingency/overhead/profit (7.5/15/25 for the tested line) + shows recommendation-text and live-updates quote-breakdown, estimate-button opens Estimator with est-trade-* + est-calculate-button, estimator-close discards, builder-close discards, quote-open-<id> opens detail modal, detail-status-SENT changes status successfully, detail-edit visible when DRAFT/SENT, quote-detail-close closes, CRM crm-tab-leads/customers switching + crm-add-button + lead-title-input/customer-name-input + crm-save-button save + lead-advance-<id> advances pipeline, Jobs job-<id> opens detail, progress-plus/minus adjust progress, job-status-IN_PROGRESS changes status, job-note-input + job-note-add adds note, job-detail-close closes. ONE BUG FOUND: logout-button clears session state (user=null) but does NOT navigate to /login — the auth guard exists only in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx and there is no guard in (tabs)/_layout.tsx, so after logout the user is left stranded on the dashboard tab with an empty 'Hi,' header and no route change. Deprecated-package check: no deprecated Expo packages (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch) present. Cosmetic RN-web console warnings persist (shadow* → boxShadow, props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents) — non-blocking.

minor.issue: Pre-existing test_auth_me case-sensitivity assertion — backend lowercases emails on register but fixture stores original case. Product not affected.

ui_bugs.issue: After tapping logout-button on (tabs)/index.tsx, useAuth().logout() clears token+user+company but the user is NOT redirected to /login. Root cause: only app/index.tsx contains a redirect based on `user`; the (tabs)/_layout.tsx has no auth guard, so post-logout the tabs stack keeps rendering with user=null (header shows blank 'Hi,'; API calls will 401). Fix: add a useEffect/Redirect in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx that router.replace('/login') when !user && !loading, or call router.replace('/login') at the end of AuthContext.logout(). Reference: /app/frontend/src/context/AuthContext.tsx:69 and /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx (no user-guard) and /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:13-14.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated — migrate to boxShadow. Non-blocking.
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated — use style.pointerEvents. Non-blocking.

action_items: Fix logout navigation: at end of AuthContext.logout() add `router.replace('/login')`, OR add auth guard in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx that redirects when user becomes null (mirror the effect in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx). Currently a logged-out user remains on the dashboard tab with a broken empty header until manual navigation.

critical_code_review_comments: Quote card restructure in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/quotes.tsx:169-195 is correct — outer <View testID=quote-{id}>, only the info area is a Pressable testID=quote-open-{id}, and the action buttons (quote-advance-{id}, quote-tojob-{id}) are SIBLING Pressables inside <View style={styles.actions}>. This eliminates the nested-Pressable bubble on react-native-web; regression verified in browser (tap advance/tojob does NOT open detail modal).

Auth routing gap: (tabs)/_layout.tsx has no user guard; app/index.tsx only guards the ROOT '/' route. Any post-login state change to user=null (logout OR token expiry) will not force a redirect while the user is on a tab route. Recommend adding a top-level redirect in the tabs layout OR performing router.replace('/login') inside AuthContext.logout().
All Quotes/CRM/Jobs onPress handlers point to real, non-empty functions (verified by grep + runtime execution). No stub / no-op onPress found.

rca_of_issue: Logout stranded-on-dashboard bug: The Expo Router auth flow has only one redirect point (/app/frontend/app/index.tsx useEffect on user), which fires only when the '/' route is mounted. Once inside the (tabs) group, no layout observes `user` from useAuth(), so useAuth().logout() successfully calls clearToken()+setUser(null)+setCompany(null) but the currently-mounted tab screen keeps rendering (empty user causes 'Hi,' blank header + subsequent API calls 401). Reproduction: 1) login jane@acme.com.au/pass123 2) tap logout-button 3) observe URL still '/' and dashboard still displayed with blank name. Mitigation options (choose one): (A) In /app/frontend/src/context/AuthContext.tsx logout() append `router.replace('/login')` using useRouter from expo-router; (B) In /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx add `const { user, loading } = useAuth(); if (!loading && !user) return <Redirect href='/login' />;` before returning <Tabs/>. Option B also fixes direct-URL access when logged out.
